newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: FORECAST-Wifo sees Austria GDP up 1.4 pct this yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Wifo sees Austria GDP up 1.4 pct this yr.

text.p: Austria's leading research institute Wifo raised on Friday its forecast for gross domestic product growth this year to 1.4 percent from 1.2 percent.
The institute, whose forecasts form the basis for the government's economic policy, kept its GDP growth forecast for 1998 stable at 2.2 percent.
Wifo said economic growth would be largely export-led as domestic demand was expected to remain subdued amid falling real incomes on the back of the government's austerity policies.
"Looked at from today, the economy will improve only step-by-step," Wifo said in its latest report.
The institute added that unemployment, currently at 4.1 percent of the workforce, was likely to remain stable while inflation should remain under two percent both this and next year.
